posts.trend: India Drives Global Growth in Premium Liquor Segment Despite Market Slowdown
posts.context: The physical reality of drinking in your thirties has turned high-end purchases into harm-reduction choices.
posts.angle: You didn't develop a sophisticated palate; your liver simply started issuing terms and conditions.
slides: You aren't buying premium single malt because you have made it.

At 22: Any brand that costs under ₹600. Zero hangover. Six hours of sleep on a carpet.

At 32: Double-aged single cask, imported water, imported ice.

One glass.

Three days of antacids.
posts.caption: Somebody you know has a dedicated medical drawer next to the premium home bar. 🥃
posts.rank_verdict: The premise and landing rely on a highly familiar, slightly overdone trope about aging bodies and hangovers.
